verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ComplyAdvantage runs transaction monitoring: transactions are processed through payment screening and transaction monitoring, there is a Transaction Monitoring agent, and TM cases and alerts can be exported. Nothing in the pack documents configuring transaction monitoring rules or setting thresholds per customer segment. The configurable risk-score equation and multiple screening configurations cover customer risk and screening, not transaction rules, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds
